subject: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan: RetailBank
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@retailbank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan: RetailBank

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for taking the time to meet today. Quick recap from our demo and a proposed POC plan to make sure we’re aligned on success criteria, timeline, and ownership. See the attached POC scope and one-pager for a downloadable outline.

Demo recap (high level):
- Showed Redwood API integration options (hosted vs dedicated) and how we preserve token-level cost metrics in the Console.
- Walked through a prototype flow for anonymized transaction summarization and redaction rules.
- Highlighted Private deployment options (VPC + KMS) and audit logging for compliance.

Proposed POC objective:
- Validate that Redwood can ingest a sample of RetailBank anonymized transactions, produce summaries with required PII redaction, and meet latency SLOs for interactive usage.

Success criteria (must-haves):
1) Functional: 90%+ of sampled summaries meet RetailBank quality rubric (precision on redaction and factuality thresholds).
2) Performance: 95th percentile latency <= 600ms for 1–2 concurrent analyst-style requests.
3) Security/controls: Private deployment with customer-managed KMS and audit logs; no persistent raw data retention beyond configured TTL.

Evaluation plan & timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff & environment setup — agree on sample dataset and access (RetailBank provides anonymized sample).
- Week 1: Integration & baseline tests (Redwood provides quickstart template and API keys).
- Week 2: Quality tuning and config (prompt sets, redaction rules).
- Week 3: Load/perf validation and handover of monitoring dashboards.
- Week 4: Final evaluation & success review; decision on next steps (expand to dedicated capacity).

Ownership & asks:
- RetailBank: provide anonymized sample dataset and a short quality rubric (5–8 representative cases).
- Redwood: provide POC environment (private deployment guidance or hosted trial with VPC options), SOW/estimates, and a single-threaded support path (CS + product).

Next steps (action items):
1) Alicia/Tom: confirm data share timeline and procurement contact (we’ll need PO or SOW approval after POC).
2) Confirm kickoff slot — I proposed Tue 16 Nov 10:00 AM PT in the call. Let me know if that works.
3) Rishi: can you confirm that KMS + VPC config for a trial with audit logs is feasible in the proposed Week 0 timeline?
4) Monica: please prepare a one-page onboarding checklist for the RetailBank POC.

Attachments: retailbank_poc_scope.pdf, redwood_poc_onepager.pdf

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
